scope: Proposition 8.1 (Filtered collision criterion) of the manuscript “A counterexample to the Colin de Verdière chromatic conjecture” (preprints/A-counterexample-to-the-Colin-de-Verdiere-chromatic-conjecture-September-23-2026/paper.pdf), one of the manuscripts of result family 157 of openai/math at commit 1581d4cbdd69. The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 97677c7a183884f0), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF page 53. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. Finding the quote shows that the manuscript states it, not that it is true. AMVO has checked nothing about this claim.
statement: Let σA, σB be two laws on units, possibly carrying finitely many colour or type marks. After forgetting these marks, suppose each law has density at most 23000gN relative to π ⊗ π. For O ∈ {A, B}, let e σO be a normalized restriction of σO of relative mass at least 2−o(N), decomposed into leaves satisfying (5.11). On each side mix the leaves with their actual masses in e σO. Fix a required predicate Ψ(A, B) on the marked units and an allowed leaf-pair indicator Jn. Use only numerical query options whose joint acceptance on an allowed leaf pair, including their separate orientation filters, implies Ψ(A, B). Suppose these accepted queries satisfy Eindependent leaf pairJn(ℓA, ℓB) Z dAdB dνn ≥ 2−o(N) . (8.3) Then independent draws A ∼ σA, B ∼ σB satisfy Ψ(A, B) and have all four cross holes with probability at least 2−(kmax+.03)N−o(N) . (8.4) It suffices to obtain (8.3) after skipping some leaf pairs, or after summing over a bounded number of numerical options. In particular, a positive subsequential overlap lower bound yields (8.4) along that subsequence. With σA = σB and Ψ the distinct-colour test, the conclusion retains that test. The statement also applies when the two sides have different prescribed law types.
